title: 第14章 龙衔宝楼
slug: 恶毒女配又装纯禁欲大佬皆沦陷
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

但五块中品灵石她肯定不同意的。

姜暮烟说道：“三块中品灵石。超过这个数我就不要了。你这雷火貂颜色不正，并非纯血脉，道友心里也清楚，它并不值五块中品灵石。我也是瞧它可怜，才出声问了个价，不是非要它不可。”

摊主咬了咬牙道：“好，三块中品灵石就三块中品灵石吧。”

姜暮烟递给他一袋灵石，摊主瞧了一眼，面色为难。

“道友，你这三百下品灵石数量虽然对，但咱们还是要按照实际情况来说话不是，三百下品灵石可换不到三颗中品灵石，这中间还有溢价呢，你这样一来，我不是白白亏损十几块下品灵石嘛。”

和铃在一旁听着。

坤舆界的灵石汇率是1：100。

中品灵石换下品灵石没有问题，但下品灵石换中品灵石则是要加几颗的。

因为中品灵石里面的灵气更纯粹，很少有人愿意拿中品灵石去换灵气更杂的下品灵石，出于补偿原则，以下换上，都是要加价的，否则对方肯定不愿意和你换。

姜暮烟态度坚决，“我身上就只有下品灵石，你就说要不要吧。”

摊主无奈地叹了一口气，“行行行，那这雷火貂我就交给姑娘了。”

姜暮烟单手起诀，一缕紫线缠绕在了雷火貂的后肢上，另一端连在她的小拇指上。

她拎起雷火貂塞进袖中，转头对和铃柔声说道：“好了，小师妹，我们走吧。”

南华城有一座龙衔宝楼，取“龙衔宝盖”的意象，极尽华贵，是宗门几位长老共同的产业，主要售卖长老弟子们炼制的丹药、法衣、灵器，偶尔也会有长老亲自炼制的法宝在龙衔宝楼挂售，但这要碰运气才能遇到。

夜弦坐在窗边喝着茶，心不在焉地扫向窗外，忽然看见一抹熟悉的倩影。

少女一袭淡淡粉裙，行来步步生莲花，笑容柔婉，天真灵动，看得出来这几日过得很好，没有一丝一毫的情伤。

“夫君？”旁边的绿衣女子顺着他的视线看去，“夫君在看什么？”

“没什么。”夜弦回神，敷衍地应道。

程芰荷声音温婉道：“我挑选了几件宝物和灵丹，打算在师尊寿辰那日献上，但不知道师尊喜爱什么，夫君可有什么建议？”

But she would definitely not agree with five middle-grade spiritual stones.

Jiang Muyan said: "Three pieces of medium-grade spirit stones. I don't want any more than this. Your Thunder Fire Ferret is not of the right color and is not of pure blood. My fellow Taoist also knows in his heart that it is not worth five pieces of medium-grade spirit stones. I also saw how pitiful it was, so I asked for a price. I don't have to have it."

The stall owner gritted his teeth and said, "Okay, three middle-grade spiritual stones, just three medium-grade spiritual stones."

Jiang Muyan handed him a bag of spiritual stones. The stall owner took a look at it with a troubled expression.

"Fellow Taoist, although the number of your three hundred low-grade spiritual stones is correct, we still have to speak based on the actual situation. Three hundred low-grade spiritual stones can be exchanged for less than three medium-grade spiritual stones. There is a premium in between. If you do this, I will lose more than a dozen low-grade spiritual stones in vain."

He Ling listened.

The exchange rate of spirit stones in Kunyu World is 1:100.

There is no problem in exchanging a mid-grade spiritual stone for a high-grade spiritual stone, but if you want to exchange a low-grade spiritual stone for a middle-grade spiritual stone, you need to add a few more.

Because the spiritual energy in the middle-grade spiritual stone is purer, few people are willing to exchange the middle-grade spiritual stone for the lower-grade spiritual stone with more mixed spiritual energy. Due to the principle of compensation, there will be an increase in price for subsequent replacements, otherwise the other party will definitely not be willing to exchange with you.

Jiang Muyan's attitude was firm, "I only have low-grade spiritual stones with me, so you can decide whether you want them or not."

The stall owner sighed helplessly, "Okay, okay, then I'll leave this Thunder Fire Ferret to the girl."

Jiang Muyan performed the technique with one hand, and a ray of purple thread was wrapped around the hind limbs of Thunder Fire Ferret, and the other end was connected to her little finger.

She picked up the Thunder Fire Ferret and stuffed it into her sleeve, turned to He Ling and said softly: "Okay, little junior sister, let's go."

There is a Dragon's Title Treasure Building in Nanhua City, which is inspired by the image of "Dragon's Title Treasure Cover". It is extremely luxurious and is the common property of several elders of the sect. It mainly sells elixirs, robes, and spiritual weapons refined by the elders' disciples. Occasionally, magic weapons refined by the elders themselves will be listed for sale in the Dragon's Title Treasure Building, but you have to try your luck to encounter them.

Ye Xian was sitting by the window, drinking tea, and glanced absently outside the window, when he suddenly saw a familiar figure.

The girl was wearing a light pink skirt, with lotus flowers appearing every step of the way, her smile was soft and innocent, and she could tell that she had been having a good few days without any emotional pain.

"Husband?" The woman in green clothes next to him followed his line of sight and asked, "What are you looking at, husband?"

"Nothing." Ye Xian came back to his senses and responded perfunctorily.

Cheng Zhihe said in a gentle voice: "I have selected a few treasures and elixirs and plan to present them to Master on his birthday, but I don't know what Master likes. Do you have any suggestions?"
